title: Minimum Window Substring
contract: Return the shortest substring of s containing every lowercase character of t with its multiplicity; choose the leftmost on ties. Empty t returns empty.
brute: if(t.isEmpty())return "";int[] need=new int[26];for(char c:t.toCharArray())need[c-'a']++;int start=0,best=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int l=0;l<s.length();l++){int[] count=new int[26];for(int r=l;r<s.length();r++){count[s.charAt(r)-'a']++;boolean valid=true;for(int i=0;i<26;i++)if(count[i]<need[i])valid=false;if(valid){if(r-l+1<best){best=r-l+1;start=l;}break;}emit("Extend until all required counts are covered","range",new int[]{l,r});}}return best==Integer.MAX_VALUE?"":s.substring(start,start+best);
optimal: if(t.isEmpty())return "";int[] need=new int[26];for(char c:t.toCharArray())need[c-'a']++;int missing=t.length(),l=0,start=0,best=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int r=0;r<s.length();r++){if(need[s.charAt(r)-'a']-->0)missing--;while(missing==0){if(r-l+1<best){best=r-l+1;start=l;}emit("Shrink a covering window","range",new int[]{l,r},"best length",best);if(++need[s.charAt(l++)-'a']>0)missing++;}}return best==Integer.MAX_VALUE?"":s.substring(start,start+best);
reasoning: Try every start and extend until all target counts are satisfied.
A deficit array tracks still-needed multiplicities; missing counts required characters, including repeats.
Once valid, shrink from the left while recording answers. Negative deficits represent surplus characters. Incrementing a deficit above zero means a required character was lost.
